newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON STORM PAST OTAGO 60-34.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WELLINGTON STORM PAST OTAGO 60-34.

text.p: The Wellington Hurricanes beat the Otago Highlanders 60-34 (halftime 20-3) in a Super 12 match at Athletic Park on Saturday.
Scorers - Wellington:- Tries: Tana Umaga (3), Christian Cullen, Alex Telea (2), Jason O'Halloran (2), Filo Tiatia; Penalty: Cullen; Conversions: Cullen (6).
Otago:- Tries: Josh Kronfeld, Matthew Carrington, Kupu Vanisi, Brett McCormack, Ace Tiatia; Penalty: Tony Brown; Conversions: Brown (3).
